title: Geologic Map of the Brookgreen Quadrangle, Georgetown and Horry Counties, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2013, Geologic Map of the Brookgreen Quadrangle, Georgetown and Horry Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-164, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; the map face is garbled. Deposits under a formation heading are tied to it from the layout and flagged inferred. Legend symbols: QHsm is on the same line as its description; QHfm, QHe, Qe and QPps are printed after their descriptions (inferred); QPpas corrected from 'oF pas' (inferred). Three thicknesses read '|' for 1 are flagged inferred and marked unclear for a check against the map image. Bodies of standing water not recorded. The sheet says its products are provided 'as is' without warranty.
SUBSURFACE: p. 1 gives elevation ranges of unit margins (Holocene terrace sediments below 10 ft at the landward margin; Princess Anne Formation 12-18 ft; Pamlico Formation 17-25 ft), stored as unit descriptions; the Princess Anne estuarine/marine unit has a lower part 10-20 ft and an upper part 1-10 ft thick. Drill holes (e.g. 20-437) are plotted with SCGS log numbers but no depths; logs on file at SCGS. No cross section or structure-contour map. Datum: base map text reads '1973 North American Datum' (as OCR'd); vertical datum for the elevations not stated.
